CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content (position/color) and an explicit origin/organization entry are listed for the same referent/time, and content vs origin are separably recorded.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition or processing-change tied to the same content's organization is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists content positions tied to named attributes (red/blue) for specific referents.

D.rationale: Content identification (positions/colors) is recorded separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referent, indicating a distinction of content vs status/organization.

O.rationale: The report provides explicit origin/organization metadata for referents, describing how the content is represented.
